generate_image: generate images from a text prompt with configurable size, seed, and sampling parameters
edit_image: edit an image using a prompt, input image, and optional mask with configurable sampling parameters
download_image_content: download a persisted image file by its image ID from the local storage
build_image_response: build an image response dictionary with b64_json or url format and common metadata fields
read_b64_for_paths: read image files from a list of paths and return base64-encoded strings
